goal: Fail scanblocks with an RPC error when reading block filters fails instead of silently omitting blocks
Prevents callers from mistaking missing filter ranges for an absence of matching transactions
reviewability: CI is red; check whether the failure is from the PR before doing a deep review
agreement: Concept approval for fixing silently ignored filter lookup failures (maflcko, fjahr)
Support for the RPC code changes (fjahr)
Objection: do not add assumeutxo test code while changes like #36598 are considered (fanquake)
Suggested dropping the test to avoid complexity and maintenance burden from assumeutxo coupling (maflcko)

categories.name: rpc
why: P1 because it fixes a correctness bug where scanblocks reports success despite missing unindexed blocks
Callers cannot tell whether an empty match list means no matches or omitted ranges, risking missed funds
